summary: Frontend-only verification of the theme picker tweaks (2 new presets + 4-stripe swatch). ALL CHECKS PASS. (A) Appearance grid renders exactly 12 preset cards (was 10); both new cards 'Red & Black' (testID=theme-preset-red_black) and 'Green & Black' (testID=theme-preset-green_black) are present with correctly colored swatches and persist selection across reload (border flips to 2px, PATCH /api/household/theme returns 200). (B) The 'Red, White & Blue' card now renders 4 stripes including a clear red stripe rgb(220, 38, 38) (the new tabActive stripe) in addition to the blue accent — the previous all-blue look is gone, and the card is now visually distinct. (C) Every one of the 12 preset cards renders exactly 4 stripes (no layout regression). Backend /api/themes/presets (authenticated) returns 12 entries with the new names in the expected order. Out-of-scope item (background-not-changing) was not retested per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: PresetCard swatch correctly composed inline (bg/card/accent/tabActive) — values are read live from `preset` props on each render, so future preset additions in /app/backend/core/theme_presets.py will work without frontend changes. Good separation.

Minor: Ionicons checkmark inside the selected card's checkBadge renders as a font glyph on web (not <svg>) so a generic 'querySelector(svg)' check misses it; the visual screenshot confirms the checkmark renders correctly and the 2px accent-colored border reliably indicates selection. Not a bug, just a note for future automation selectors — consider adding testID="theme-preset-{id}-check" on the checkBadge View if a stricter assertion is ever needed.

Pre-existing tech-debt from iteration_26 (StyleSheet.create captures `colors.*` at import time so live repaint of non-preview UI does not happen) is intentionally NOT addressed in this iteration per the user-queued plan. No new regressions introduced.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only iter; backend /api/themes/presets sanity check returned 12 entries)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme presets endpoint is auth-protected (Bearer token required) — use login at /api/auth/login → access_token then GET /api/themes/presets. The 12 presets in order: red_white, red_white_blue, gold_black, red_black, green_black, royal_blue_black, royal_blue_white, pink_white, purple_white, green_white, teal_white, dark. All cards expose testID=`theme-preset-{id}` and selection is reflected via borderWidth=2px on the selected card.
